us: Talks advance on two-lane safe-passage proposal
effects: 44 redirected · No tanker evaded since Jul 12 · Brent −7% to $83
iran: Explosion near tanker off Omani coast · Crew safe · Un-designated lanes called 'targets'
tldr: Mediators circulated a draft reopening traffic via an Omani southern lane and an Iranian northern lane — Iranian ships going first — in exchange for lifting the blockade. That night a cargo ship was struck on the Omani stretch itself; oil gave back its war premium.
